meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的需求生成多个独立的水平方向网页设计参考图，每个页面区域一张图，并确保构图多样、风格统一、可直接用于前端开发。
howto.when: 当你要求设计落地页、营销网站或产品展示页面时触发。例如说“帮我设计一个落地页”或“生成一个网站模板”。

say.text: 帮我设计一个8个区域的落地页，每个区域一张图。
say.note: Claude 会生成8张水平图，每张对应一个区域。

say.text: 生成一个SaaS产品的营销网站首页参考图。
say.note: Claude 会按默认6个区域生成6张图。

say.text: 设计一个极简风格的品牌官网，每区域一张图。
say.note: Claude 会采用极简构图和配色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates multiple separate horizontal website design reference images, one per section, with varied compositions and a consistent palette, suitable for frontend development.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for landing pages, marketing sites, or product page designs. For example, saying 'Design a landing page' or 'Generate a website template'.

say_en.text: Design an 8-section landing page, one image per section.
say_en.note: Claude will output 8 horizontal images, one per section.

say_en.text: Generate a marketing site homepage reference for a SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will default to 6 sections and produce 6 images.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist brand website reference, one image per section.
say_en.note: Claude will use minimalist composition and palette.
